Work in a fast paced environment reviewing many accounts to identify potentially high risk/suspicious merchant processing activity to protect the firm against financial loss. Resolve merchant inquiries through scheduled calls. Complete special projects as assigned. You will read and interpret documents. You will calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages. You will exercise discretion and independent judgment in making decisions and interact effectively and positively with all levels of personnel, partners, and vendors. Partner cross-functionally with brand, creative, community, PR, partnerships, data science, product, paid media, and publishing teams, and manage relationships with external partners
Represent player marketing in executive conversations — clear, confident, well-prepared storytelling on strategy and impact, not just status updates

10+ years of marketing experience, including several years in player, lifecycle, or growth marketing for games or other live, player-facing products

Track record of prioritizing ruthlessly across a high volume of concurrent workstreams, rather than trying to do everything

Experience working with external partners, licensors, or IP holders
